behavior.defaultDownload: Ordinary native HTTP download. P2P is an explicit context/more-menu choice only.
behavior.sender: With host PCDN enabled, capable pages silently send by default. No recipient sharing consent dialog or post-completion stop-sharing workflow. Page-wide opt-out remains ephemeral and independent of explicit receiving.
behavior.cache: One aggregate page-local verified-body cache shared across files/jobs, default64MiB, live host range0..64MiB;0 frees retained chunks. Output buffers, browser internals and metadata are not included in this retained-body budget.
behavior.expiry: Default3600s, live host range1..86400s. Host-verified offers/new coordination, download progress and actual transfers renew same-version file activity. Idle polling does not renew. Expired data is checked before reads and by a bounded timer; background freezing can delay timer execution.
behavior.retention: Download completion closes output and file participant but retains verified page cache for later host assignments. Different file versions never share blocks. Passive tasks can switch files without discarding unrelated retained blocks.
behavior.largeFiles: P2P entry requires a secure context plus showSaveFilePicker for files exceeding the memory-only ceiling. Explicit selection opens the standard native save dialog and writes1MiB verified windows, with existing-file rehash/resume. No Service Worker download bridge ships.
behavior.memoryOnly: Maximum32MiB desktop /16MiB narrow screen; deviceMemory hints may reduce this to4MiB. Unsupported large files do not advertise P2P and continue using ordinary downloading.
behavior.cli: --p2p-cache-mb0..64; --p2p-cache-seconds1..86400 default3600; --p2p-seed-seconds remains an alias with the new idle-expiry meaning.

limits: Native save dialog and multi-GB/TiB endurance have not been tested in a real browser; disk APIs are covered by handle doubles
deviceMemory is a coarse optional hint, not a measurement of available memory; ordinary download remains preferable under memory pressure or for very large files
PCDN64MiB budget covers retained verified body blocks, not all process/browser memory or temporary download output
Background page suspension can delay cleanup/leases and cause node fallback
First missing piece of a passive relay still requires host data; savings require cache reuse
No external STUN/TURN and no guarantee of savings, throughput or WebRTC reachability
Received data cannot be revoked; client-reported byte counts are advisory
No new dependency; project Apache-2.0 licensing retained
